# Monetary Amount

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MonetaryAmount>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A quantity of money expressed as a decimal value in an explicit currency reference frame. The canonical superset of [schema:MonetaryAmount](https://schema.org/MonetaryAmount) and [FIBO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-fibo-fnd-pas-ps) [fibo-fnd-acc-cur:MonetaryAmount.](https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/MonetaryAmount.) Frame-relative ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)): a value without its currency frame is ill-formed.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

Use [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

### Double Entry

- **Source:** [`slices/extensions/finance/examples/double-entry.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/extensions/finance/examples/double-entry.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-extensions-finance-examples-double-entry)#example-slices-extensions-finance-examples-double-entry

```turtle
# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Blackcat Informatics® Inc. <paudley@blackcatinformatics.ca>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: CC-BY-4.0
#
# Worked example: money is frame-relative, and the ledger is double-entry
# P11). Every gmeow:MonetaryAmount carries its gmeow:currency as a REFERENCE FRAME
# — "5000" is meaningless; "5000 in the CAD frame" is a coordinate. An invoice is
# recorded as a balanced gmeow:JournalEntry: two gmeow:Postings to gmeow:Ledger-
# Accounts, one DEBIT and one CREDIT of the same amount, so the books balance by
# construction. Debit Accounts-Receivable (an asset), credit Revenue.
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/finance/> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

ex:amount a gmeow:MonetaryAmount ;
    gmeow:monetaryValue "5000.00"^^xsd:decimal ;
    gmeow:currency      gmeow:referenceFrameCAD .
```

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for any quantity of money — a price, salary, fee, balance — so the amount always travels with its currency frame; consumed by employment, agreements, and finance alike (it lives on the measurement spine, not in a finance silo).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for a unit-bearing physical quantity (use [`gmeow:Quantity`](gmeow-Quantity.md) with [`gmeow:hasUnit`](../properties/gmeow-hasUnit.md)) and avoid stating a bare amount without [`gmeow:currency`](../properties/gmeow-currency.md) — a value without its currency frame is ill-formed ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).

### How to use

- Mint the amount, set [`gmeow:monetaryValue`](../properties/gmeow-monetaryValue.md) ([xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal)) and the required [`gmeow:currency`](../properties/gmeow-currency.md) reference frame; the generated frame-relativity shape ([`gmeow:requiresFrame`](../properties/gmeow-requiresFrame.md)) enforces exactly the currency the amount is denominated in.

### Examples

- ex:price a [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md); [`gmeow:monetaryValue`](../properties/gmeow-monetaryValue.md) 19.99; [`gmeow:currency`](../properties/gmeow-currency.md) ex:usd.
